name: reply-after-peer-close
description: A request that waits for the page ends when the peer closes its connection, and the host records the reply to the closed connection as not sent, not as an error; the later reply of the page is an observation.
reason: The page of the case is a script that the host producers play; a running application has a page of its own that answers differently.

log.line: info host endpoint: connection closed: peer closed
info host endpoint: reply to 9 not sent: peer closed
info host exposure: exposure reply 1 arrived after its request ended
